model: src.ml.expert_pipeline focus horizon week_7 (custom logistic/regression bundle, configs/ml_expert.yaml + ml_research.yaml), its own yearly walk-forward with train_end_date moved 2022-12-31 -> 2019-12-31 so test years = 2020..2025; nothing else changed
selection: each week's first trading day, universe mid_small (the universe the 08-Apr live run selected); rank = target_zone (pred_return_7d in [5%,10%]) first, then 0.55*prob_5pct + 0.20*prob_10pct + 0.75*clip(pred_return,±20%) — the live ranking_score minus calibration (monotone) and the 0.10 aux-horizon weight, which the OOF file doesn't carry; top 12
outcome: equal weight, enter next open, exit close of trading day 126 (~6 months), 0.30% RT
report: per entry year 2020-2025 and pooled: mean/median 6M return, % picks up, % weeks beating the mid_small universe median, worst week; secondary: liquid_5cr_plus universe
limits: regime gate (fail-closed weekly gate) not replayed — every week invests; panel is today's repaired one
